meta.name: geopandas
meta.description: Guidance and local audit tools for Python workflows that directly use GeoPandas GeoSeries, GeoDataFrame, spatial operations, or vector-data I/O.

copy.tagline: 审核并指导GeoPandas空间数据处理流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用GeoPandas处理地理空间数据并需要质量保障。
copy.tagline_en: Audit and guide GeoPandas spatial data workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with GeoPandas for geospatial data and need quality assurance.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会指导并写出用 GeoPandas 处理地理矢量数据的 Python 代码:读写 Shapefile/GeoJSON/GeoPackage 等文件,做缓冲、空间连接、叠加、溶解等操作,处理坐标系,并绘制静态或交互地图。
howto.when: 当你说要处理地理矢量数据,如读取 Shapefile/GeoJSON 等文件、做空间分析(缓冲、连接)、转换坐标系或画地图时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 GeoPandas 读取这个 GeoJSON 并画个地图
say.note: 会生成读取和基础绘图的 Python 代码。

say.text: 把两个图层按相交关系做空间连接
say.note: 会使用空间连接给出合并结果。

say.text: 把数据投影到 EPSG:3857 并计算面积
say.note: 会演示换坐标系和面积计算代码。

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude guides and writes Python code using GeoPandas to handle geospatial vector data: reading/writing Shapefile, GeoJSON, GeoPackage, etc., performing buffers, spatial joins, overlays, dissolves, handling coordinate reference systems, and creating static or interactive maps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to work with geospatial vector data: reading files like Shapefile/GeoJSON/GeoPackage, doing spatial analysis (buffers, joins), transforming coordinate systems, or making maps.

say_en.text: Help me read this GeoJSON with GeoPandas and plot it.
say_en.note: Generates code for reading and basic plotting.

say_en.text: Spatially join two layers by intersection.
say_en.note: Uses spatial join to combine results.

say_en.text: Reproject the data to EPSG:3857 and compute areas.
say_en.note: Shows reprojection and area calculation code.
